criteria.requirement: Repair UniversalDetector startup to buffer only incomplete possible BOM prefixes until a complete UTF8/16/32 or unusual UCS4 BOM can be distinguished, then use existing detection semantics. Handle UTF16-vs-UTF32 prefix overlap, arbitrary byte/empty chunks, near-prefix mismatches, EOF partial prefixes and reset reuse without losing or duplicating bytes. Ordinary non-BOM input must start probing immediately; preserve original labels, confidence, all probers and frozen upstream tests.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
